page.title: Geography
page.description: Events per country, by the country of their source or destination address.
page.failedHeading: The country counts could not be shown.

widget.title: Geography
widget.unsupportedDirection: The saved direction is not one this version knows; Source addresses are shown.

state.notCollected: Nothing has been collected for {direction} in this range, so no map is drawn. The QRadar property that carries the country may not be configured, or collection has not run in this range.
state.insufficient: Buckets were collected for {direction}, but no address resolved to a country, so no map is drawn.

map.aria: Map of events by country, {direction}. Largest: {top}. The table lists every country.
map.outlinesFailed: The map outlines could not be loaded.
map.outlinesFailedAction: The table has the same figures. Reload the page to try again.
map.share: {share} of the events with a country

table.label: Events by country
table.top: Top {shown} of {total} countries. The Geography page lists all of them.
table.undrawn: {count, plural, one {# country is} other {# countries are}} too small for the map outlines and not drawn: {names}. {events} events are in the table.

facts.partial: The counts cover only the measured buckets.
facts.lowerBound: Some buckets are lower bounds, so every count is at least what is shown.
facts.unresolvedNote: UNRESOLVED counts events whose address is private, internal or unknown to GeoIP. The lookup returns the same empty result for all three, so they cannot be told apart.
facts.overCapNote: Over the country cap counts the events of countries beyond the 64 busiest in a bucket; they are summed, not listed.
facts.unparseableNote: Unparseable counts events whose lookup result could not be read as a country. It is a defect count, never a country.
facts.fromLookup: From the GeoIP lookup of the address
